entries.en: to confess on the strength of evidence (indicia); to own up when confronted with clues

entries.zh: 错认；违心招认（承认自己本不愿承认之事）
entries.en: to acknowledge against one's will; to confess what one would rather not admit
to confess one's sins item by item; to make a confession of guilt
to admit and confess guilt (item by item)

entries.zh: 口词多；口供冗多，即有许多事要招供
entries.en: to have much to confess; to give a lengthy oral statement

entries.zh: 食认；认账、承担罪责（已招认者又因疑心攀连他人）
entries.en: to own up to a charge; to accept blame (and, having confessed, to implicate others on suspicion)
entries.notes: L 栏尾段“tener mura”疑为 murmura（风闻）之省写，语义取 H/M“食认”的认罪义

entries.zh: 替；托人代做，倚仗他人代为
entries.en: to rely on another to act for one; to have someone stand in for one
entries.notes: 单字词头，R 栏声调污损（T99），与 L“confiar en otro”的对应系据“替人”义推断

entries.en: to lean on; to rely on another
entries.notes: M 栏标[残]且两音节声调均污损，释义依 H“靠”与 L 互证

entries.en: 〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: H 栏“律”标[疑:彼]，M 栏全残，R 音 cūn 无法与 H 对应，不足定夺

entries.en: to lean on; to depend on
entries.notes: M 栏原稿音写缺失，释义依 H“倚”与 R“y”及 L 三者互证

entries.en: to rely on; to presume upon

entries.zh: 换（交换）；与“倚赖”义不合，疑为形近讹字
entries.en: to exchange (does not fit “to trust in another”; probably a misread character)
entries.notes: H 栏“換”与西语 confiar 不相应，M 栏全残，R 仅存 othuan，无法定夺

entries.zh: 怙；仗恃、依靠（怙伊扶持：靠他扶助）
entries.en: to rely on, to lean on (怙伊扶持: to depend on him for support)
entries.notes: H 栏并列“怙 伊 扶持”三成分，R 音 ciu y hun chy 不能与 H 逐字对应

entries.zh: 顾、怙；寄望于他人（将所盼之事托于别人）
entries.en: to place one's hopes in another; to look to someone for something
entries.notes: L 栏含残字，H 栏“省”标[疑:皆]，M“cua cou”取顾怙二音，释义依 L“寄望于他人”

entries.zh: 管顾；照管看顾，倚仗他人照应
entries.en: to look to another's care; to rely on someone's protection
to rely on power or influence; to presume on one's standing

entries.zh: 缔交；结交订好，与人结托相倚
entries.en: to form a bond of friendship with; to attach oneself to another
to lean on; to rely on
to depend on; to rely on
entries.notes: M 栏另有旁注插入“tog nay”，与第 21 条托赖重出，正字仍作倚赖

entries.en: to rely on power or influence; to trade on one's standing

entries.zh: 托赖；托福、仰赖他人庇护
entries.en: to rely on another's favour or protection; to be indebted to someone
